nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Chin Acne Pimple Patches

segments.oily: Reviewers with an oily T-zone or oily chin report the patches absorb excess oil and gunk overnight, leaving skin feeling less oily and less inflamed.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive-skinned are split: several say the patch caused burns, irritation, or wrinkled skin, while others say their sensitive skin had no reaction and even that breakouts on that area were prevented.
segments.combination: One reviewer with an oily T-zone and drier areas near the mouth/chin reports the patch cleared that zone effectively while feeling gentle.

concerns.dehydration: One reviewer notes the patch dried out her skin even while helping breakouts surface faster; no other reviewer reports dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the patch reduces blemishes and clears pores but leaves the skin red afterward; most other reviewers do not mention redness as a side effect.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the patch forming a barrier over an inflamed area that helped it heal without irritation; two others describe burns or a chemical-burn-like reaction after overnight wear.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report the patch draws out visible gunk, whiteheads, and clogged-pore material from the chin overnight, though a few say nothing came out and the whiteheads remained.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers describe reduced hormonal chin breakouts, hormonal acne clusters, and cystic pimples after repeated use; a few report the patch did nothing for their blemishes or blackheads.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers who describe oily or congested skin report the patch pulls out oily gunk and leaves the area feeling less oily; no dissent noted on this specific point.

aspects.libelle: Size too small for full chin
Expensive relative to quantity in pack
Causes burn or irritation on removal

extraits.titre: Left a burn on my chin
extraits.texte: Had a couple pimples on my chin, put this on at 11pm- took it off by 7am and when I removed it, it removed a layer of my skin. It looks like a chemical burn. I do not recommend for people who have sensitive skin. Picture was first day, looks worse now

I normally love Mighty Patch's standard pimple patches, so I thought these would be effective for the cluster of white heads on my chin that never seem to go away. Turns out, not so much. Took three different strips to finally get a successful application without the strip folding in and sticking on itself (which is a huge bummer when there's already not that many strips in the package, especially considering the price). Followed the directions as stated on the package, kept it on for twelve hours, and the next morning, nothing on the patch, and the whiteheads were still there. But I did get a lovely irritation burn to deal with for the few days. 🙄 So, sensitive skin friends, beware. All-in-all, save your money, save your skin, and just get hydrocolloid bandages from the pharmacy if you need a larger surface area covered than a typical pimple patch.

very expensive for what you get. i would not say they work better than other competitors on here. i found they dry my skin out, but do allow acne to surface to clear breakouts faster. they're very hard to get off the packaging and it will curl on the corner if you try to get it off

extraits.titre: Works well but leaves skin red
extraits.texte: It does reduce blemishes and clears pores on the chin well but leaves my skin red afterwards.

I received this product for free to review. Regardless, I am a flutist of over 15 years of experience, and I have very sensitive skin. Before this patch, I always had small whiteheads and even large under-the-skin pimples that would appear on my chin due to hours playing flute and touching my face from time to time. Going to bed with this patch at night was not only comfortable, but put the work in! After approximately two nights, all of the bumps on my chin had diminished, and playing flute no longer hurt to push up against what might have been pimples on my chin. I will definitely purchase a pack with my own money once I run out! Thank you, Hero!!!

I've used Mighty Patches before, but this was my first time using this size. It's great! I have an oily t-zone, and this really helps clear up my chin and the area near my mouth. It's super effective, yet gentle. I will definitely buy these again.

Love this patch! My skin has always been sensitive around my chin and is one of the first areas to break out. These patches help prevent breakouts and keep the area less congested. Will be buying more!
